html:
If you’re a small business owner, you probably have a good idea of just how big the small business community is – but these statistics might put it in perspective. Small businesses play a huge role in keeping our local economies healthy and our communities close, so it should come as no surprise that the numbers reflect that impact. Read on to learn more and see how Meridian Local has helped small businesses make their marks.
